decision.explanation: The question asks when Attorney General Lawrence served in his position. From the original sources, there are two distinct referents named 'James Lawrence' who served as Ohio Attorney General: one from 1884–1886 and another from 1900–1902. These are separate individuals with the same name, so both terms are valid answers. Other candidates (1792 and 1971) refer to different individuals (Nathaniel Lawrence and Bert Lawrence), and thus are not relevant to the question about 'Attorney General Lawrence.'
